questions.q: Which of the following is an amorphous solid?
questions.solution: Amorphous solids are the solids in which atoms are arranged in a completely irregular manner. They are also known as glassy solids.

questions.q: For a constant hydraulic stress $P$ on an object with bulk modulus $(B)$, the fractional change in the volume of object will be
questions.solution: Bulk modulus, $B=\frac{-\Delta P}{\Delta V / V}$ or $\left|\frac{\Delta V}{V}\right|=\frac{P}{B}$
